what: BOK Financial is a Tulsa-based bank lending across Oklahoma, Texas, Colorado and the Southwest, with unusually large energy lending, mortgage trading and wealth management businesses.
customers: Businesses and households across the American Southwest, plus institutional clients of its trading and wealth arms.
money: mortgage trading, brokerage, trust and wealth management
moat: Energy lending expertise built over decades in Oklahoma and Texas, which lets it underwrite oil and gas credits that other banks avoid, plus a large fee business that diversifies the earnings.
risks: Energy lending exposure means oil price downturns raise credit losses
Mortgage trading revenue swings with interest rates
Revenue has grown slowly, from $1.9B to $2.2B in four years
opportunities: 11.5 times earnings with a 26.6% net margin and $720M of free cash flow
$1.7B of cash and analysts see about 13% upside
Fee income is roughly a third of revenue, far more than most banks of its size
watch: Energy loan credit quality and fee income growth.
